app_context.name: 3D Learning Family - Kitchen Studio Visualizer
app_context.description: B2B pitch demo and parametric 3D kitchen studio configurator featuring real fastener-level assembly explode, corner diagonal geometry, cabinet merge/unmerge logic, dual dimension readouts, togglable ceiling pot racks, and live manufacturer white-labeling.
app_context.theme: Dark Luxury Industrial Studio (Dark Mode Native)
app_context.target_audience: Cabinet Manufacturers, Architectural Designers, Kitchen Showrooms, B2B Pitch Prospects

typography.font_family_body: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif
typography.pairing_strategy: Industrial Precision Pair: Display Sans for bold headlines and status callouts + Monospace for dimension callouts, fastener counts, assembly vectors, and BOM calculation.

colors.archetype: Architectural Obsidian & Tactical Warm Gold (ARCHETYPE 2 & 5 Hybrid)
colors.tinted_grey_rule: Neutrals are subtly tinted with slate indigo (#0D0F12 / #1C2029) to create deep cinematic contrast without lifeless pure black.
colors.contrast_standards: WCAG AA / APCA compliant text contrast. High contrast on text overlays over glass panels.

grids_and_layouts.mode: Full-bleed 3D Studio Workspace with Floating Tool Dock & Collapsible Inspector Panels
grids_and_layouts.main_layout: Full screen viewport (h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden grid grid-cols-12 relative bg-[#0D0F12])

structure.header_nav: Fixed top bar (z-50 h-14 w-full bg-[#14171D]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2E3545] px-4 flex items-center justify-between)
structure.left_sidebar: Col-span-3 lg:col-span-2 absolute top-16 left-4 z-40 w-80 max-h-[calc(100vh-5rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-[#14171D]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#2E3545] p-4 shadow-2xl
structure.center_3d_viewport: Absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0F1218] to-[#08090C]
structure.right_inspector: Absolute top-16 right-4 z-40 w-96 max-h-[calc(100vh-5rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-[#14171D]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#2E3545] p-4 shadow-2xl space-y-4
structure.bottom_dock: Absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 bg-[#1C2029]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-[#2E3545] px-6 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-4 shadow-2xl

surface_strategies.card_style: bg-[#1C2029] border border-[#2E3545] rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-[#47536B] transition-colors

key_functionalities_and_ui.brand_customizer: Pitch mode top toolbar allow real-time client logo insertion, custom brand name update, and primary accent color swatches.
key_functionalities_and_ui.dimension_unit_toggle: Instant toggle between Metric (mm) and Imperial (inches) across all parametric indicators, bounding boxes, and BOM items.
key_functionalities_and_ui.fastener_explode_inspector: Staged slider (0% to 100%) and stage buttons (Assembled -> Panels -> Hardware -> Fasteners) separating screws, hinges, and slides along real 3D assembly vectors.
key_functionalities_and_ui.corner_turned_section: Hero cabinet preset button loading true L-shaped / diagonal carcass geometry with 45-degree angled face.
key_functionalities_and_ui.merge_unmerge_logic: Select 2+ adjacent base cabinets -> Merge button. Computes primary Logical Run Length (e.g. 1524mm / 60in) and secondary Wall Footprint (e.g. 1524x610mm). Maintains underlying child fasteners for explode engine.
key_functionalities_and_ui.ceiling_pot_rack_system: Hidden by default ceiling system. Double-tap/toggle header icon turns on ceiling layer with selectable pot rack types (Industrial Steel Frame, Rustic Wood Beam, Brass Hanging Ring, Modern Track Grid).
key_functionalities_and_ui.illustrative_bom_and_quote: Live pricing readout panel with configurable pricing parameters (labor rate, finish multiplier, fastener count surcharge) and exportable itemized BOM list.

render_pipeline: Procedural PBR materials for Oak, Walnut, Matte Black Poly, Quartz Countertop, Stainless Steel, Brass, Subway Backsplash
Soft shadow plane and contact shadows under cabinet legs
Fastener instancing for screws/dowels during explode state
Dynamic dimension vector lines in 3D canvas using Drei Html or Line components
3d_libraries_and_steps.lighting: Environment studio preset with key directional light at intensity 1.5, fill ambient light at 0.4, and soft spot highlight on active cabinet.

motion.framer_motion_usage: Animate panel drawer slides, tab switching, explode stage badges, and modal open states.
motion.hover_states: All action buttons must have explicit micro-interactions: transform scale 1.02, brightened border, glowing shadow.
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling continuous spinning and instant-snapping 3D camera controls.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, swatches, sliders, buttons, inputs, tabs, and readouts MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_check: Ensure hover states set both bg and text color explicitly. Example: hover:bg-[#D97706] hover:text-white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Frontend uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Do NOT use TypeScript annotations or .tsx extensions in components.
Build a full-bleed 3D kitchen studio workspace rather than a generic landing page.

Implement @react-three/fiber 3D canvas as the core experience with procedural 3D cabinet rendering (base cabinets, corner L-shaped diagonal carcass, drawers, doors, undermount slides, 35mm cup hinges, 32mm system holes, and screws).
Support genuine fastener-level exploded assembly where screws and hinges animate outward along X/Y/Z vectors based on stage slider (0% to 100%).
Include dual dimension indicators: Logical Run Length (primary) and Wall Footprint (secondary) in both mm and inches.
Implement Merge / Unmerge functionality for adjacent units that computes combined dimensions while keeping child fastener arrays intact for explode inspect mode.
Implement invisible/hidden by default ceiling feature with a header toggle and double-tap gesture that enables selectable pot-rack styles.
Add a live pitch customization bar allowing prospective cabinet manufacturers to drop in their company name, logo URL, and accent color.
Provide a detailed illustrative BOM and Quote calculation breakdown panel with parameter toggles.
Add data-testid to every interactive and data display element for testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic light SaaS themes or simple centered cards. Use a rich dark studio environment with crisp borders, glassmorphism overlays, and precise industrial typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing system (p-4 to p-8 inside cards) to avoid text-border collisions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_states: ALWAYS set explicit text color on hover alongside background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use specific CSS transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than transition: all.
